title: Durable storage Terraform guardrails: EBS/EFS/S3 encryption, snapshots, and health checks
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Goal: Build a single, opinionated Terraform module that provisions EBS volumes, EFS filesystems, and S3 buckets for Redwood Private (VPC) deployments with safe defaults and operational guardrails. The module must: enable customer-managed KMS by default (auto-create fallback key when no key provided), enforce encryption-at-rest and in-transit, enable S3 Block Public Access and bucket-level logging, enable S3 versioning and configurable lifecycle rules for snapshots/archival, provide snapshot rotation policies for EBS/EFS (Data Lifecycle Manager + AWS Backup integration optional), and expose healthcheck hooks (CloudWatch metrics + SNS alerts) and observability tags. Non-goals: supporting every downstream cloud provider (AWS-only initial launch), deep multi-account cross-region replication in this ticket (follow-ups will handle replication and cross-account roles).
design_decisions: 1) KMS: default behavior is customer-managed key (CMK) if provided; otherwise create a CMK with rotation enabled. CMK policies will restrict decryption to the deployment account and a small set of infra roles. 2) Snapshots: EBS uses Data Lifecycle Manager for practical snapshot lifecycle; for EFS we produce lifecycle policies to infrequent storage class and propose an optional AWS Backup plan. 3) S3: buckets are private by default, versioned, encrypted with s3-managed or customer CMK, and include lifecycle rules and retention guardrails to avoid accidental deletes. 4) Health checks: export CloudWatch alarms for failed snapshot jobs, low free space for EFS, and S3 bucket access anomalies; alarms push to SNS topic configurable at module input.
variables_and_outputs_summary: Key variables: enable_kms(boolean), kms_key_arn(string, optional), enable_versioning(bool), snapshot_retention_days(int), lifecycle_transitions(list of maps as JSON string), enable_backup_plan(bool), healthcheck_sns_topic_arn(string, optional), tags(map as JSON string). Outputs: ebs_volume_ids (list as JSON string), efs_filesystem_ids (list as JSON string), s3_bucket_names (list as JSON string), kms_key_arn(string), healthcheck_alarm_ids(list as JSON string).
upgrade_strategy: Module will provide a migration guide and opt-in flags for new hardened defaults. For existing resources created by older modules, include 'adopt_existing' boolean; when true, module will attempt to import resources (documented manual import steps) and create supplemental resources (alarm/backup) without destructive updates. Breaking changes will be gated behind a major module version with explicit upgrade notes and Terraform state upgrade steps.
testing_and_validation: - Unit: terraform validate + checkov/cfn-nag style scans on generated plans. - Integration: deploy to a staging VPC, run snapshot lifecycle jobs, validate encryption keys, and trigger health alarms. - E2E: run a canary that writes/reads to S3/EFS/EBS and simulates snapshot retention policy. - Contract tests: verify outputs schema and tag propagation. CI pipeline must run 'terraform plan' and 'terraform apply -auto-approve' against a disposable account namespace and teardown.
acceptance_criteria: Module can create EBS, EFS, and S3 resources with encryption enabled by default
CMK auto-create fallback works and rotation is enabled
Snapshot lifecycle runs and older snapshots are pruned according to retention policy
S3 buckets created block public access, are versioned, and have lifecycle/archive rules applied
CloudWatch alarms created for snapshot failures and EFS low-space conditions and send to provided SNS topic
Module supports adopt_existing flow and documents manual import steps
Automated tests (unit/integration) pass in CI and a staging deployment verifies end-to-end behavior
notes: Design sketch and variable list in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-storage-module (internal)
Security: require security review for CMK policy and SNS topic principals - flagged for SecOps review
Ops concern: snapshot retention default set to 30 days to balance cost and restore needs; can be varied per environment
